{"mimeType": "text/markdown", "text": "# match3d-backend - prod deploys
How prod works for the ZM backend since the prod env went up (match3d-backend#2).

Merging doesn't deploy anything. Dev is deployed by hand from main. Prod runs from the prod branch: to put a PR on prod you cherry-pick it onto prod, build a new zm-api task definition revision and update the service (steps on the CI/CD Pipeline & Branching page). Only the PRs picked onto prod are on prod.

Whoever deploys a PR to prod comments on that PR with a line starting "prod:", the time in UTC and the task definition. That comment is what puts the PR on prod, not the merge and not a Slack message.

A prod deploy only counts if the PR already had an Approve review from someone other than its author when it went out. Approving afterwards doesn't fix it; redeploy.

To roll back, revert the pick on prod, redeploy and comment "rollback:" on the PR. A rollback takes the PR off prod whenever it happens, freeze or not, until a newer "prod:" comment.

Console changes and spreadsheet imports have no PR: they go in the deploy log, Console & imports tab, with what changed or what was imported, the target (dev or prod) and the time.

Freezes: from the server freeze on the calendar until the beta ships, the Approve review has to be Arthur's. Anything else deployed during the freeze gets rolled back at go/no-go.

The deploy log also has a Prod deploys tab as a quick list.

content.text:
I've done the server side of the beta sign-off: the register is in the folder, Arthur has his reply, the tickets that aren't on prod are back in Todo, and Leonard has the register with comment access.

**Result: 18 tickets in scope, 9 on prod and 9 not.** Following Arthur's rules on the Trello beta card plus his later comment, a ticket counts if it went to Done between the Aug 25 prod cut and Sep 30 and needed a backend PR or a console change/spreadsheet import from the deploy log. I decided "on prod" by the prod deploys doc: a "prod:" comment on the PR, an approval from someone else before the deploy, no later rollback, and Arthur's own approval for anything deployed after the Sep 26 freeze.

- **On prod (9):** ZOM-459, 509, 510, 531, 537, 444, 499, 547, 553.
- **Not on prod (9):** I moved each back to Todo with a comment saying which change still has to go out:
  - ZOM-336 (#40) and ZOM-435 (#51) were only ever deployed to dev.
  - ZOM-392 (#41) was deployed before it was approved, so the deploy doesn't count.
  - ZOM-518 (#43) was deployed with no approval at all.
  - ZOM-256: the algo levels 2.0 level pack was only imported to dev.
  - ZOM-487: #48 is on prod, but the boss arena HP table was only imported to dev.
  - ZOM-550 (#50) went out during the freeze without Arthur's approval; he only commented "ship it after go/no-go". Under the freeze rule it gets rolled back at go/no-go.
  - ZOM-503: #42 is on prod, but #52 went out during the freeze approved by someone other than Arthur, so it also gets rolled back.
  - ZOM-557 (#54) was rolled back on Sep 28 and never redeployed.

**What I did:**
- **Register:** saved as "ZM Beta sign-off - server side register" in the ZM Beta sign-off folder. It has one row per ticket with its server changes, Y/N, and the evidence, plus a note on how I applied the rules.
- **Arthur:** replied in your DM with the count and the list of tickets not on prod, with reasons.
- **Leonard:** shared the register with him directly with comment access, as he asked, and replied briefly to his email to say it's there.

**Worth knowing before Thursday:**
- Two earlier claims don't hold up. You told Arthur on Sep 22 that the 100+ algo seeds had been on prod since the 3rd, but that deploy doesn't count, so the seeds aren't on prod by his rules. You also said the trophy path double-claim fix (#51) was out, but it was only ever deployed to dev. A QA note in Slack on Sep 27 said all the server fixes were on prod; the PR and deploy records say otherwise.
- The deploy log has five imports that went only to dev and that no ticket mentions: plague race, trophy path copy, loadout, analytics events and economy tables. I left them off the ticket rows and listed them in the register's notes.
